connection_types.spec: hatch: printed tongue under a fixed lip at one end, hook-and-loop tab at the other (tool-free, no magnets)

edges.notes: shell floor, XPS LE filler, side walls and aft wall bonded to bare, sanded foam: D1 cuts the recess (x_rec0 ... x_rec1, z = pod base, full pod width) and leaves the tape skin off under the pod (CR-C2-07); skin then taped over the shell foot (CR-D2-04)

bond.load_case: L1 landing; C1 crash any axis

edges.notes: tray front piece (with the forward stop) and rear piece, FC, avionics, PDB and UBEC plates and the JR bar epoxied full-area to the foam-board floor (paper face scuffed); 6 mm microballoon fillets floor-to-side-wall over +/-30 mm of each strap (CR-C6-17) and over x -0.100 ... 0 (CR-C3-01)
